Paver & Brick Calculator

Paver calculator for patios and walkways: paver count plus base gravel and bedding sand in cubic yards.

How many pavers?

Pavers per square foot = 144 ÷ (paver length × width in inches). A standard 4 × 8 in brick paver is 4.5 per sq ft. Add 5–10% for cuts, more for curves or herringbone patterns.

Example: 200 sq ft of 4 × 8 pavers: 200 × 4.5 = 900, plus 10% = 990 pavers. A 4 in base is 200 × 4 ÷ 12 ÷ 27 = 2.47 cu yd of gravel; 1 in sand = 0.62 cu yd.

Base layers

  • Walkways and patios: about 4–6 in of compacted crushed stone base
  • Driveways: 8–12 in base depending on soil
  • About 1 in of coarse concrete sand for bedding, screeded flat

Compact the base in 2 in lifts, slope about 1/4 in per foot away from buildings, and finish with polymeric sand in the joints.
